title: Sharp pushout attachment comparison
statement: Use small simplicial sets, weak equivalences and monomorphisms of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-model-right-proper-core], sharp maps of [lem-coef-sharp-pullback-calculus], and pushouts of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $i:X\to Y$ and $f:X\to X^{\prime}$ be maps, and let $Y^{\prime}=Y\amalg_X X^{\prime}$ with structure maps $g:Y\to Y^{\prime}$ and $j:X^{\prime}\to Y^{\prime}$. Let $p:X^{\prime}\to A$, $h:A\to B$ and $q:Y^{\prime}\to B$ satisfy $qj=hp$. Assume $p$, $pf$ and $qg$ are sharp, $f$ is a weak equivalence, and either $i$ or $f$ is a monomorphism. Then $q$ is sharp.
